displayName: Center for Internet Security (CIS) Benchmarks for Windows Server
description: This policy provides you the ability to customize and deploy CIS Security Benchmarks for audit purposes to your Windows Server across Azure, on-premises and hybrid environments. The contents of the CIS Security Benchmarks are in parity with the benchmarks published at https://cisecurity.org. Requires that prerequisites are deployed to the policy assignment scope. For details, visit https://aka.ms/gcpol.

metadata.description: By selecting this option, you agree to be charged monthly per Arc connected machine.

Optional filter applied to every evaluated resource (Azure VM and Arc machine). Only resources whose 'kind' matches this value are evaluated. Use 'None' to disable this filter. Azure VMs do not have a 'kind' value, so setting this to AWS/GCP will exclude them from evaluation.

Optional inclusion tags filtering to limit which resources the policy applies to. Add any number of name/value pairs to the 'tags' array. Use AnyTags when any one tag can match, or AllTags when all specified tags must match. Leave 'tags' empty to apply the policy to all matching resources.
A customized Baseline Security JSON payload, for customizing security rules
Enable or disable the execution of this policy
